📌 Tehran, IRNA — The Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) says it has shot down a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island in the Persian Gulf, marking the 18th such drone it has downed.

In a statement on Tuesday, the IRGC said the reconnaissance and combat drone, belonging to the US military’s MQ-1 family, was intercepted and destroyed by a newly developed advanced air defense system operated by the IRGC Aerospace Force over the southern part of Qeshm Island.
​
It added that this is the 18th US MQ-1 drone to have been destroyed by the IRGC Aerospace Force’s air defense systems. The continued interceptions, the IRGC statement said, demonstrate the force’s air defense capabilities and the ability of its young, elite officers to counter the enemy’s advanced military equipment.
